credits.title: Gallina
credits.overview: In rural Spain, ten-year-old Pablo loves spending time at his granny’s countryside home, playing with his younger sister Alba and his best friend Martín.  But everything changes when Martín pressures him to betray his family.

credits.title: Los perdedores
credits.overview: David (16) is a neighborhood kid with a gambling problem. After receiving a tip about a fixed match, he does whatever it takes to get money to bet, regardless of the consequences. David enters a spiral of bad decisions that will directly affect his family.

credits.title: Dismantling an Elephant
credits.overview: A mother is trapped by both a close bond to her daughter and a day-to-day life whose elephant in the room is her own addiction, which nobody mentions, remaining a taboo.

credits.title: Mentiste, Amanda
credits.overview: Amanda and Virgi are two inseparable friends, but nothing will ever be the same when one afternoon, a man crosses their path.

credits.title: Low Tide
credits.overview: Luisa falls in love for the first with her neighbor Anna while she spends her summer vacation at the beach with her family. At the same time, Luisa will find out something about her parent's relationship that will make her question her ideals of love and inevitably grow up.

credits.title: Love and Other Misfortunes
credits.overview: Interweaves 16 stories that happen in the province of Alicante, Spain.
roles: Inspectora Candela: La química del amor
